segments.en: Just now his letter arrived together with his heartfelt blessing — a cheque in the amount of one hundred Israeli liras. And joy upon joy was added to me — from the writing of such holy words — which are so hidden and concealed from the world. From the very depths of my heart I express to his lofty honor many thanks and expressions of gratitude for the goodness and the kindness he has bestowed upon me. May Hashem recompense his good deed — and may his reward be complete. May he receive blessing from Hashem. A good year and a blessed one for him and for his household — and may they merit to see the revelation of truth in the world, and may they lengthen days and years upon his kingdom in abundant good.

To the honor of the President of Israel — the delight of my eyes, who dwells in my heart always — Mr. S.Z. Shazar, who desires to tread in the paths of the wisdom of the Nachal Noavaya — the father of all the wise ones, who illuminates the eyes of Israel — how to go out from the flood of the waters of the Flood of heresies and faiths of foolishness and vanity and falsehood and falsehood. Because of this, Hashem desired him and arranged wondrous causes — until the bond and the union between us was established and perfumed. And from this a wondrous child was born to us — Ebay HaNachal — at which all marvel and are astounded and are astonished — and they receive it with love and fondness and great joy. For it gives drink to Israel from the waters of truth flowing from the Nachal Noavaya. May Hashem inscribe and seal you for a good and sweet year — and may He bind you and unite you with the true leader — for a long, good, healthy and fresh life, Amen.

Blessed is the Good and the Beneficent — blessed is He Who bestows good kindnesses upon His people Israel. We are obligated to give thanks and to praise Hashem for all the good that He has bestowed upon you and upon all Israel — that He preserved your soul in life and did not allow your foot to slip. Hashem knows the hidden things of the heart — He knows how much and how much I share in your pain and suffering. And the prayers and the weeping that I pour out over you before the Master of Mercy — that He have compassion and mercy upon you and upon His people Israel, and send His word and heal you and restore you completely — for a long and good life, a life of faith and complete teshuvah, through the power and the merit of all the Tzadikim — and at their head the true leader of this generation and all generations: Rabbainu the awesome — Rabbi Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman.

I rely upon the measure of your goodness and the mercy of your good heart — to ask for pardon and forgiveness for the fact that I have not written until now. For I am ill and suffer very harsh, hard and bitter pains and sufferings. And I am confined to my house and have no connection whatsoever with the world. May Hashem have mercy and say to our troubles: "Enough."

The contribution of one hundred liras for the help of the previous Pesach festival I received on the 13th of Nissan 5731. Also the contribution of two hundred and fifty liras that you sent me through my son-in-law Chaim — I received it in its time and in its season. May Hashem recompense his good deed — healing and salvation in body and soul, and a healthy and pleasant long life.

One must overcome oneself with all one's strength to distance the sadness and to be only joyful always — through what one has merited to know of the secret of the greatness of Rabbainu — the light of all lights, the awesome and wondrous wonder, hidden and concealed from all the worlds: N'chal N'ovaya M'kor Ch'uchma — who is the healing for all kinds of ailments in body and in soul.
I long with all the expiration of my soul to see the pleasantness of his face — and especially on the eve of Rosh Hashana, as is my custom every year.

To the honor of the President of Israel — the delight of my heart and the crown of my head — Mr. S.Z. Shazar, who carries his soul to the hidden wisdom of the Nachal Noavaya Mekor Chuchma — who has promised us that through him Torah will not be forgotten from Israel. May Hashem bless you from Zion with a good and blessed year in a long and good life.

My beloved, my brother — my heart and my soul. Be strong and courageous and greatly rejoice and exult with all your might — with an endless joy — in the greatness of the kindnesses of Hashem that He has bestowed upon you. That you have merited to such a good gift — to know and to believe in the true leader, the Nachal Noavaya — through whose merit and most awesome power Hashem will certainly not abandon you — not in this world and not in the World to Come. For he walks before us and said before his passing: "Az ich gaiy far aich, vos hot ir tzu zorgen?" {Since I go before you — what do you have to worry about?}
And know — that our wondrous child, Ebay HaNachal, is already performing great effects in the world — and in the generations to come after us he will be very dear and important.

Fortunate are we — how good is our pleasant portion — that we have come into the world at such a time in which the light of all lights — the pure, lustrous wonder of wonders — has been revealed. He who is the entire essential foundation and root of our vitality and our hope and our consolations.

Trembling and alarm seized me and I was crushed exceedingly — from the great anguish and bitterness of my heart that reaches to the very heavens — upon seeing that after all the goodnesses and great and awesome wonders that the Master of Wonders performed with us, to make known to us of such a new light — Na Nach (N.N.) — which is an awesome wonder, most supernal of the supernal, surpassing all the wonders of all the generations from the day of the creation of the world — even so after all this, there penetrated into our territory a storm wind and a great cloud, which is the Satan, the prince of slaughterers, who strives and lies in ambush to slaughter and to butcher the person from both worlds — and who wishes to break our covenant of love and to corrupt and to nullify, Heaven forbid, such a strong and eternal bond as Hashem placed between us (for our benefit and for the benefit of all Israel wherever they may be). For he fixes his eyes and gnashes his teeth at all who wish to enter into the palace of the King of Israel and their redeemer from generation to generation — the Nachal Noavaya.

And know, my brother — that we need abundant mercy that we merit to stand on guard for our souls — to battle the accusing Satan with great power and great heroism — to subdue him, to shatter him, and to nullify him entirely. Would that my eye were a source of tears — and I would weep day and night over our many and immense sins and transgressions that have caused this bitter trouble, which touches upon us and upon all Israel — until our sins be transformed into merits through the power of Rabbainu the awesome — N.N. And may we merit afresh to hold and to unite together in love — truly and with a whole heart — with the true hidden and concealed leader.

To the honor of the President of Israel — the crown of my head and the crown of truth crowns his head — Mr. S.Z. Shazar, whom Hashem chose from all Israel and stirred his spirit and set his heart ablaze like a burning fire — to set ablaze and to kindle the heart of Israel toward the Nachal Noavaya, through whose great power all Israel will be repaired in perfection and will all be turned to Hashem Yisburach — even those who are utterly distant will know Hashem and crown Him with the crown of kingship. Blessing and peace and life without end.

All the days of my life would not suffice to sing and to hymn and to praise Hashem — for the immensity of the awesomeness of His kindness and His wonders that He performed with me — that He gave me true grace and true love and great mercy in his warm and pleasant heart — to stand by me and to fight for me with self-sacrifice — a strong, long and hard battle with the Knesset member M. Pairush — until Hashem helped to defeat him and subdue him, so that I would have a holy place to labor in it with holy service: Torah and prayer and hisbodidus and conversation between me and my Maker, etc.

And now, after all this goodness and this awesome kindness that you have performed with me — I will rejoice and exult — to bring you the good tidings and the mazal tov of the new and most wondrous salvation that was born to us in Tiberius on the eve of Purim before the reading of the Megilla. For the Chief Rabbi of Tiberius, the wise Rabbi Meir Weknin, fulfilled his request and will completely and with a glad heart — he invited me to his home and honored me greatly, and said to me: Know that I am giving you as a gift for all the days of your life — the most beautiful and pleasant room on the third floor of the new building of the yeshiva upon the burial site of the Tanna, Rambeva'hNess — as well as a new bed and mattress and a bookcase. And he blessed the honor of the President — may his glory be exalted — with great emotion and passion, over the fact that he had granted him such good. And he said trembling the verse: "Fortunate is the people who have such" [Psalms 144:15] — that they have such a President — a man of kindness with such a pleasant and pious soul.

Who can express and explain the immensity of the value of this noble and beloved mitzvah — through which the honor of Hashem was magnified and made precious, and through it there were made most awesome pleasures and great satisfaction for the Blessed Holy One throughout all the worlds! Had you come into the world only for this — it would have been sufficient.

This wondrous matter became known and publicized and made a great noise throughout the entire city of Tiberius. And all extol and bless the honor of the President — may his glory be exalted — with all their heart.

Just now the contribution of his good heart arrived — the amount of one hundred Israeli liras. And it was for me great satisfaction and joy. Gratitude upon gratitude — many thanks and blessings from the very depths of my heart for this kindness and for all the many goodnesses and kindnesses he bestows upon me with all his strength at every time and at every moment. May Hashem recompense his good deed — and may He draw upon him and his household salvation and mercy and peace and a long and good life — of the holy and most awesome Beggars. If you only knew even a small amount of how very greatly you gave me life with these holy rooms that you labored and toiled over so greatly — so that I could serve Hashem in truth with a whole heart — you would certainly be glad and strong to run with all your strength to the true leader, the Nachal Noavaya — who is Moshe-Moshiach — who even now labors to elevate us even from apostasy to desire.
And may the Blessed Holy One grant you a kosher and joyful Pesach — and let us rejoice and be glad in it.

To my beloved, my dear, my dearest and most beloved — my heart and my soul — Mr. Shimshon Efrati, may Hashem guard him from all illness and pain and heal him and his household speedily and completely for a long and good and true life, Amen.

Please, please — judge me favorably and do not hold any grievance or resentment whatsoever against me for not having replied to all your precious letters — which are most pleasant to me beyond measure. And behold — after the previous Pesach festival I came home and found your two letters — most precious to me above all wealth. And I read them with love and immense and great joy. And at once I prayed for you and your household — that Hashem have mercy upon you and sweeten and nullify from you all the anguish and the sufferings passing over you, and grant you healing and salvation in all matters — in body and in soul.

And know, my dear beloved brother — that I have great satisfaction every time that I merit to see your handwriting. For all your words come from your heart in truth. And I see in them that the Blessed Holy One has graced you and given you a heart that understands one thing from within another — and beautiful and precious vessels more precious than fine gold — so that you are able to receive within them the hidden and concealed light that is now found in our days in the world. Which surpasses all the wonders of all the generations from the day the world was created. He is our awesome Rabbainu, the Nachal Noavaya — who has made known to us that he is the true leader in our generation and in all the generations to come. And he is able to take us out and to elevate the entire world from all the descents and the darknesses and the impurities and the filths — and to repair the entire world and return all of them to Hashem and His Torah — even those utterly distant from the holiness of the Torah, and even the nations of the world — that they all will know Hashem and serve Him in unison.

Every single word that issued from the mouth of Rabbainu the awesome descends lower and lower to the very depths of the great abyss — and elevates everything higher and higher above the very heavens. Who can assess their praises — who can tell the awesomeness of their greatness — there is none like them.

To the honor of the President of Israel — my soul and my heart — Mr. S.Z. Shazar, whom Hashem delights in and with whom He glories, and has placed upon him the crown of kingship and made him king over Israel — in order that he have mercy upon them and strive with all his strength, with self-sacrifice — to match and to join the people of Israel with the Nachal Noavaya, the new, awesome and wondrous light — who lowers himself to the very depths of the abyss to rescue and to take out all souls from there, and elevates them above the very heavens. A good and blessed year in life and blessing and peace and healing, Amen.

A song of love, a song of friendship, a song of thanksgiving — I will sing to you, my soul and my heart, with love and exceptional fondness — for you have found grace and kindness in his good heart. For he performed wonders with me — with immense labors and in a long, strong and difficult battle with the Knesset member M. Pairush — until he merited to subdue him, so that I should have a place of rest, a holy place to engage in it with the service of Hashem — Torah and prayer and hisbodidus and the outpouring of my soul before Hashem. Fortunate is his portion that he merited to this — such a great and awesome thing. Certainly he will have an equal portion with me in my service of Hashem in this world and in the World to Come.

How very pained I am for you, my dear beloved brother — for the great anguish of your suffering from the illness of your precious wife, may she live. I feel your pain in the very depths of my heart — for your pain is my pain. I pray always in every prayer and at every time of favor for your wellbeing and your good in body and soul. And especially now — from the day I heard of the illness of your precious wife, I exert myself with all my strength to pray for her healing speedily. May the Master of Mercy have mercy upon Rachel daughter of Zelda — and may He send His word and heal her speedily. And may He add upon you years of good and healthy life — and may you merit to see speedily the glory of the revelation of the light of truth — the new light, N.N. — which surpasses all the great lights that were and will be.

To the honor of the President of Israel — the daughter of my eye and my heart — Mr. S.Z. Shazar, to whom Hashem has given an understanding heart — to understand the secret of the awesomeness of the greatness of the Nachal Noavaya — who has revealed great and wondrous novelties beyond all reckoning, through which He will take us out from within the depths of the descent and the concealment, and will repair everything in perfection. May he receive blessing and salvation from Hashem, Amen.

The fire of my love for you — which burns in my heart always — will kindle and never be extinguished forever. "Many great waters cannot extinguish it" [Song of Songs 8:7], Heaven forbid. We must always be together — even when we do not see one another. For the bodies are distant — but the souls are very close. For we are bound together in the true truth — the Nachal Noavaya — which is all our hope and our vitality from generation to generation forever.

The immensity of the anguish I have from your suffering — from the illness of your precious wife — there is no way to measure. For your pain is literally my pain. With a bitter heart I shed many tears in my prayer and supplication before Hashem Who hears the prayer of every mouth — that in His great mercies He have compassion upon us and remove her illness from her. May He send His word and heal her — and may she return to her full strength completely, speedily, Amen.

My heart exulted and rejoiced and was glad — on Sunday, the 2nd of Adar I, I merited to receive from his special emissary his great contribution in the amount of three hundred Israeli liras. It greatly gave life to my soul — for now after the operations I am in need of recuperation. I am also glad to inform him that on the eve of the previous Sukkos festival there arrived in my hands his doubled, tripled and quadrupled contribution in the amount of four hundred Israeli liras. And because of my serious illness I was unable to write an acknowledgment — nor was I able to properly fulfill the mitzvah of the sukkah as fitting. In the month of Marcheshvan I entered Hadassah Hospital under the supervision of Professor Zaltz — and I underwent three operations, and was in great danger. And through the greatness of the kindnesses of Hashem — through miracle and wonder — I came out in peace.

I hold in my heart all the good things that you have done for me from then until now — kept and sealed in the King's treasury forever and ever. A thousandfold thanks and expressions of gratitude from the very depths of my heart. May Hashem recompense his good deed — and may He grant him grace and mercy before Him always, and fulfill all his desires for good. And may He have mercy and speedily give a complete healing to his precious wife, Rachel daughter of Zelda, Amen, so may it be His will.

Many worlds thunder and shake from the wondrous deed he has performed — in bringing out to light the holy book Ebay HaNachal. Eminent Torah scholars have drawn close through it — and many true ba'alei teshuvah have been made. We must greatly rejoice in this. Fortunate are you and fortunate is your portion that you have merited to this.

To the honor of the third President of Israel — the delight of my eyes and my heart — Mr. S.Z. Shazar, who has merited to understand and to taste the pleasantness of the secret of the awesomeness of the greatness of our Master, the Nachal Noavaya, who walks before us to save us from the fowler's snare — and to repair and to heal our souls in perfection. A good and blessed year from the source of blessing — in all the salvations in body and soul — for a long, good life and endless peace.

From the straits I have raised my voice and cried out to you — from the depths of a melted and broken heart, and all my bones cry out to you. Please, my brother — arouse afresh your powerful love with which you have truly loved me, with all fondness and brotherhood, and you have performed wondrous kindnesses for me with immense self-sacrifice — without measure and without limit — these sixteen years. And therefore I beseech and supplicate from his lofty honor — that he conduct himself with me even now with the measure of his goodness and his humility beyond the letter of the law. And may he judge me favorably and grant me full pardon and forgiveness for all my failings — and let it not be bad in his eyes and let not his anger be kindled against me at all for any failing. Only to fulfill in me: "In wrath, remember mercy" [Habakkuk 3:2]. For a person is not held accountable for his pain. For from the time I underwent the operation I am very seriously ill in all my body, in all my limbs. And I am afflicted with very harsh, hard, bitter and most bitter pains and sufferings beyond measure — not upon you. I lie almost always in bed and have no connection whatsoever with the world. Only I pour out my heart before Hashem Yisburach in hisbodidus — with warm words — that He have mercy upon us and save us within all of Israel.

Please, please — overcome yourself with the power of your wisdom and your upright intellect — to battle the Satan and to subdue him, so that he should not be able to accuse and to rule over us to separate us from one another, Heaven forbid. For this is a great loss to us, etc. For all our repair and our hope and the repair of many souls depends upon this.

Zisser bruder, halt zich, luz dich nit op — {My sweet brother — hold yourself firm, do not let yourself go, do not abandon yourself, do not weaken}. Be strong and let us strengthen ourselves. And let us not be like the great elephant and the camel — even when a mouse pulls him by his nose, he does not kick it. And all of this is because of the foolishness of not knowing his own strength. But your soul, which is alert and strong — gird yourself like a warrior. And bind your loins with strength, to fly like an eagle to the true Tzadik — the aspect of Moshe-Moshiach — who heals every illness and is a man of pains. Blind and lame, leprous and afflicted — he brings souls out from the nethermost depths, transforms descents into ascents and deliberate sins into merits. Fortunate is one who merits to draw close in his lifetime to the true Tzadik. Fortunate is he, fortunate is his portion. For the adversary has set his mind very much upon this now — to confuse the world. For Israel is very close to the End now and there are very great longings and yearnings among Israel to Hashem Yisburach — such as have not been in the days of old. And every single person longs greatly to Hashem Yisburach. Therefore the adversary has cunningly introduced dispute among the Tzadikim, and has raised up in the world many false famous ones — until no one knows where the truth is. Therefore we need greatly to multiply prayer and supplication greatly — to merit to draw close to the true Tzadik.

Truth and falsehood are the aspects of king and slave. Know that there are two kinds of palaces: in one dwells the king and in the second dwells the slave — and both of them resemble one another completely. And it is very difficult to distinguish between them. For there are several souls that bind themselves until a house and a palace is made from them — for they bind themselves one to another and one to another, until a foundation is made from them. And afterwards a tent is made, until a house and dwelling is built from them — where the truth dwells. And whoever wishes to find truth will find it in this house and palace of these souls from whom a dwelling for truth has been made. And there is a parallel to this — where several souls bind themselves and a house is made from them where falsehood dwells, which is the aspect of the slave. And between these two aforementioned houses it is possible to err — meaning between truth and falsehood. For falsehood likens itself to truth — for there too there is a bond of many souls — until it is very difficult to distinguish between truth and falsehood. And a person may err and not know where the truth is and to which he should draw himself close.

It is upon us to praise and to say the complete Hallel and the Great Hallel — for specifically now in our very days we have a true, holy and most awesome rabbi and leader — who is the healing for all our blows, whatever they may be. And through him there is already hope for our future — even for the worst of the worst, etc. For the greater the patient, the greater the doctor that is needed. And had the world merited — even now — to benefit from his light, the world would already have come to its complete repair.

The Blessed Holy One is sending after us and calling to us at every moment, and hinting to us hints — to draw close to Him Yisburach. And one must deepen and magnify his thought in this — to understand His hints Yisburach. And sometimes a person is greatly aroused with a great arousal — to cleave and to bind himself to the Tzadik upon whom depends all the holiness of his Jewish identity. Only the adversary provokes greatly against this, until he causes the person to be distanced and expelled from the holiness of his Jewish identity to a place of desolate wilderness — a very dangerous place — and lies in ambush for him to trap him in his snare. And then he can make a frantic deed and what appears in truth to be madness — and no human intellect would agree to this, how it would be possible to achieve such a thing. But even so, because of his true arousal, Hashem gives him success and he merits to cross over all the fences and obstacles and to shatter them all — until he merits to complete the matter in perfection.

The greatest wisdom of all the wisdoms — is not to be wise at all! Only to be sincere and upright in simplicity. Even one who truly has a great mind must cast away all the wisdoms and engage in his service of Hashem Yisburach with simplicity and sincerity. And he must even conduct himself and do things that appear to be madness — in order to do His will Yisburach. For one must roll oneself in all kinds of mire and mud for the service of Hashem and His commandments. And not specifically for a commandment as such — but any matter in which there is the will of the Blessed Holy One is called a commandment. And one must roll oneself in all kinds of mire and mud in order to do some will and some satisfaction for Hashem Yisburach.

And when his love is so powerful toward Hashem Yisburach — then he is in the aspect of a very precious and beloved son to Hashem Yisburach. For there is the aspect of a son who searches in the king's treasury like a son. And there is the aspect of a slave who has only to do the work given to him — and he is forbidden to ask any reason or investigation about his work. But there is a son who loves his father so greatly that because of the love he performs the work of a slave — what an ordinary slave must do. And he goes and leaps into the great ramparts, into the ties of battle, and rolls himself in all kinds of mire and mud — in order to do satisfaction for his father, what even a simple slave would not do such labors. And then when his father sees his love so powerful — to the point where he casts himself into complete servitude for the sake of his love — then he reveals to him also what is not transmitted even to a son. For there are places where even the son is forbidden to enter — meaning there are attainments that even the son does not attain. But through the son removing all his wisdom and casting himself into servitude as above — through this his father has mercy upon him and reveals to him what is not transmitted even to a son. And allows him to search in the most hidden and concealed royal treasury — until he merits that the aspect of "a Tzadik and it is bad for him, a wicked one and it is good for him" is revealed to him. And he merits to elevate the justice that has fallen to the abyss and to repair it. For he merits to attain "a Tzadik and it is bad for him, a wicked one and it is good for him" — which appears to be a perversion of justice. And now when he merits to attain and to understand this — this is the aspect of the repair of justice. Through a true rabbi with disciples, all the aforementioned aspects are made and repaired.

When a person goes after his intellect and his wisdom, he may fall into many errors and stumbling blocks — and come to great evils, Heaven forbid. As many have already stumbled and fallen greatly through their evil wisdom and have sinned and caused the masses to sin — Heaven have mercy. For the essential Judaism is to walk in sincerity and simplicity without any wisdoms — and not to regard one's own honor at all. Only if there is in it honor of Hashem Yisburach, do it — and if not, do not. Then certainly he will never stumble.

The entire essential repair of the world depends upon this: that all the paths of the evil and confused wisdoms — from which all kinds of heresies and apostasy also flow — should be nullified from the world. And to bind oneself truly to the true Tzadik, who can repair everything — even in all the places and all the matters that pass over us.

It is forbidden to despair — only to search after holiness at every time. And even if it seems to him that according to what he knows within himself — the wounds of his heart and his pains — it is very far that he will attain holiness. Even so, he will do his own part and search after it with all his strength. And even if it seems to him that also after this search, these many years, he has not yet found and has not yet attained any level of holiness at all — even so he will search more and more. Until if the person is truly strong in this all the days of his life — Hashem Yisburach has mercy upon him and helps and assists him above the way of nature and human intellect entirely. Until he merits to pass through everything in peace and to complete the matter — to bring out the holiness from the klipos.

A destroyer has come into our territory — and he is the head of all our oppressors. He has placed an iron siege upon us, laid snares in our paths. He fixes his eyes and gnashes his teeth at us — to roll upon us and to fall upon us, to annihilate us and to destroy us from our Jewish identity. And every single day the cup of his poison is renewed and strengthened upon us to give us to drink — and it is entirely beyond our power to stand against him. Therefore Hashem performed wonders with us and prepared the healing before the blow — and brought down to us the true Tzadik, the select of the select Tzadikim: the N'chal N'ovaya M'kor Ch'uchma — to give drink to the entire earth with wisdom and knowledge of Hashem through his deep counsels and his repairs. To purify the impure, to wash the filthy, to acquit the guilty, to redeem the burdened by sins, to atone for deliberate transgressions, to gather the displaced, to take out the imprisoned, to give freedom to the captives.

In our days a destroyer has come into our territory — and he is the head of all our oppressors. He has placed an iron siege upon us, laid snares in our paths, spread nets for our feet. He fixed his eyes and gnashed his teeth at us — to roll upon us and to fall upon us, to annihilate us and to destroy us from our Jewish identity. And every single day the cup of his poison is renewed and strengthened upon us to give us to drink — and it is entirely beyond our power to stand against him. Therefore Hashem performed wonders with us and prepared the healing before the blow — and brought down to us the true Tzadik — who is the one true rabbi and leader of our generation and all the generations to come — the head and most select of all the select Tzadikim. To give drink to the entire earth with wisdom and knowledge of Hashem — through the rivers and streams of his wisdom and his repairs and his deep and sincere counsels. To purify the impure, to wash the filthy, to whiten stains, to acquit the guilty, to atone for deliberate transgressions, to bring the distant close, to gather the displaced and the lost, to take out the imprisoned from confinement, to revive the spirit of the lowly, to gladden the heart of the despairing and the sorrowful.

Fortunate is one who merits to be saved from those who err and stray in darkness and blackness — who cannot see and gaze upon the light of the true Tzadik, who is the root of all the Tzadikim of all the generations. And he will complete in perfection all the repairs that the Tzadikim of all the generations began to repair the world. For even the great Tzadikim have not yet completed this matter in perfection. And only he will complete all the repairs and repair the entire world in ultimate perfection. And through the greatness of his power all who come into the world will return to Hashem Yisburach — and will all fulfill the Torah. And he will subdue and nullify all the heresy and the apostasy — and will draw great faith in the world in ultimate perfection. And he will illuminate in the world the revelation of His G-dliness through a most wondrous revelation — the like of which has never been heard or seen from the days of the world.

There are souls that have fallen very, very much — having fallen so greatly without end, in the shame of their sins — to the point where they are entirely unable to return to Hashem Yisburach. And no repair in the world is possible for them — except through the soul of the true Tzadik, who has in his great power the ability to take each and every one out from every place he has fallen to — and to elevate him and to repair him. And then the joy is very great. For there is no joy before Him Yisburach like the time when those most distant are returned in teshuvah. For Hashem Yisburach desires kindness — and He watches over the wicked and desires his vindication. And all the time that the person is distant from Him Yisburach through his sins, He is greatly pained — as it were — and thinks thoughts that none of His displaced ones be lost to Him. And therefore, through the Tzadik elevating and repairing the distant and displaced — who were displaced and fell to the very depths of the nethermost abyss — and returning them to Hashem Yisburach — through this the joy is magnified greatly and greatly. Like returning to the King his son whom he had banished from before him because of his sins. And through his having been distanced he corrupted even more every time — because he fell in his mind when he saw the enormity of his distance from the King, to the point where he erred and imagined in his mind that the King had distanced him forever. And he did not hope to return to the King — as it says: "he does not believe he will return from darkness" [Job 15:22]. But in truth the King has great pain at all times and remembers his distant son at all times. And when one is found who has mercy upon the King and upon his son — and goes to the defiled place where he has fallen, and hints to him hints and conducts himself with him with a most wondrous wisdom — until he implants within him thoughts of teshuvah and returns him to the King.

When the power of the filth of the serpent grows stronger, Heaven forbid — which is the defiled places — and he becomes very distanced from the holiness of his Jewish identity and is wandering and driven and tossed about, pushed from his holiness from push to push — until it wishes to completely topple him from the point of his Jewish identity, Heaven forbid. Then the holiness of the Jewish soul is aroused — and then specifically, if he is strong and courageous and begins to seek and to search and to probe and to burrow at every moment, and to pine and to long to find Him Yisburach — then, even though many days and years continue to pass and he does not yet merit to find Him Yisburach and to draw close to Him — even so let him know and believe that at every time and every time, through each and every request, and through each and every seeking that he seeks and requests and searches to find the honor of His holiness Yisburach — and through every single glance and longing when he looks and lifts his eyes to His mercies Yisburach — and through every single movement when he turns toward holiness — through all this he merits every time to shatter iron walls and copper doors. Even though afterwards they strengthen against him each time more, Heaven have mercy — even so his effort is not in vain, Heaven forbid. And no single movement that turns toward holiness is lost, Heaven forbid. For many times and seasons and many days and rivers and abysses and changed waters must pass over him. And through many wildernesses filled with great and awesome serpents and scorpions he must pass — until he merits to enter through the gates of holiness in truth. And if he is strong and courageous as a lion — to seek and to search even more, even if what passes over him passes — he will certainly in the end merit to find Him Yisburach. Until he merits to ascend to the ultimate ascent. And all of this is through the power of the true Tzadik. For were it not for his great power we would not have even the strength to seek and to search at all — and Heaven forbid they would have drowned, and there would be no recovery, Heaven forbid, for the fallen and the distant who have become so distanced from holiness. And especially now when there are people who have fallen to abysses without end, etc. And from where would they receive vitality and strength to be aroused yet again — to seek and to search for His honor Yisburach and to return to Him Yisburach — certainly, Heaven forbid, their hope would have been lost, Heaven forbid. But in truth, through the power of the true Tzadik who has merited to the aspect of "Ayeh" (Where is the place of His glory?) — through this all the fallen ones have the power — even to the defiled places, etc. — to search: "Ayeh", etc. — until they ascend to the ultimate ascent.

The true Tzadik always inclines toward the side of merit — and finds good in each and every one of Israel. For he knows how to gather all the aspects of the good hairs that are found in each and every one of Israel. And through this he engages in the healings of each one — even if he is very, very gravely ill in sickness of the soul. For he finds within him also good points — the aspect of hairs — meaning what he separates himself from evil to good, even by a hairsbreadth. And this hair is the aspect of a pipe and a vessel through which the Tzadik draws down upon him also intellectual conceptions and contractions — until he implants within him also conceptions of G-dliness. And this is the essential greatness of the Tzadik — when he is able to heal even the most gravely ill.
"The Torah of Hashem makes armies of those schooled in faith."
Myen darf zich zeyer yogin myen zol noch kenin epis chapin — {One must hasten greatly so that one can still seize something.}

The days of exchange come and go — and every single day one draws closer to the day of death. And one is compelled to go upon this path without doubt — whether it is near or far. But in any case everything will pass like a passing shadow. And we must in any case begin from now — to have compassion and mercy upon ourselves with true mercy — to prepare our steps for the World to Come, and to prepare provisions for such a distant journey. And we are filled with sins and iniquities and great transgressions and evil desires and many corruptions, without measure, without worth and without number. And we are very, very far from the purpose — and we have not yet gone from the secular to the holy even by the width of a thread. And we must hasten to flee our souls from the fowler's snare. And therefore let us strengthen ourselves and gird ourselves with great alacrity — to flee and to run to the Tzadik, upon whom depends the wholeness of the repair of our soul and all the hope of Israel. Who illuminates within us the illumination of the will with such great power — until he illuminates the world and will not be interrupted in any kind of darkness that passes over every person, according to what he is. For through this he elevates even from the aspect of apostasy to will. The essential service of the Tzadik is to clarify and to elevate the good from the very depths of the evil. And he elevates even the most fallen souls — by finding merit for them. Even for the utter wicked — the worst of all — as long as the name of Israel is called upon him, he searches and requests and finds some merit, however small — and through this he elevates them also from the very depths of the evil. And the good is clarified and the evil is pushed away and entirely nullified. And this is the aspect of the revelation of Moshiach — {who will gather all the displaced from the four corners of the earth}.

When a person falls to the place where he falls — even if he falls into very disgraceful ways which are the aspect of the defiled places, and even one who falls, Heaven forbid, into doubts and imaginings and questions about Hashem Yisburach — even so there is no despair in the world whatsoever. Even though it seems to him that in his place, Hashem Yisburach is not to be found at all — Heaven forbid — because he has fallen to such defiled places, Heaven have mercy. Even so let him be strong and determined and overcome himself greatly — to seek and to request and to search after the honor of Hashem Yisburach. And when he asks and seeks and requests the honor of Hashem Yisburach — and is pained and longs and cries out to Hashem Yisburach, and yearns to return to Him. Even though he knows of no way or path or counsel or stratagem — how it is possible to rise and to return from such places so distant from Hashem Yisburach — even so, through the very seeking and searching itself — that he searches and requests Hashem Yisburach, asking: "Ayeh — where is the place of His glory?" — through this itself he ascends to the ultimate ascent. In the aspect of "the descent is the ultimate ascent." And this itself is his teshuvah and his repair. For through the descent he has — through this he searches and requests: "Ayeh — where is the place of His glory?" And through this, when he merits to search and to seek well — he merits to ascend to the ultimate ascent, to the aspect of Ayeh — which is the root of everything. And he draws from there new vitality.

There is a true Tzadik who merits to live a good life in which there is no lack whatsoever. And he specifically appears to be deaf — because he does not hear any sound of this world at all. For all the sounds of this world are only from deficiencies — for each and every one cries out over his own deficiency. And even all the joys of the world are only because of the deficiency that he lacked and that has been filled for him. And therefore he is called deaf — for the entire world does not rise in his sight enough for him to hear their deficiency. And his good life is bread and water — but in his bread and water one can taste all the flavors and all the fragrances and all the sights in the world and all kinds of pleasure in the world — so that through them they live a truly good life without any lack whatsoever!

There is such a garden in which grow wondrous fruits and produce — which contain all the flavors and all the fragrances and all the sights in the world. And the entire world would be able to live a truly good life through this garden. And over this garden there is a gardener — called an agradnik — meaning such a holy and most supernal Tzadik who is appointed over it and always tends to all the repairs of the garden. And sometimes — through the sin of the generation — the gardener is lost, through whom they were all able to live a truly good life through the garden. And this gardener, even though he goes about and says that he is the gardener — the world considers him a madman, Heaven forbid. And they throw stones after him and expel him — and therefore he is unable to tend to the repairs of the garden. And through this everything that is in that garden is certainly compelled to come to an end and be cut off — since there is no one appointed there, meaning the gardener.

And behold, even though there are certainly such exceptionally great Tzadikim who have great wealth and great spiritual treasuries — who also boast that they live a good life — even so, the corruptions from the blemishes of the world can corrupt also in their case the flavor and the fragrance and the other aforementioned things. And certainly they have no power to repair the world and to restore to them the good life they would have been able to live through the aforementioned holy garden. And therefore when their own good life has also been corrupted — then their entire repair is through the Tzadik of most lofty stature — who is the aspect of the deaf one, who lives a good life in which there is no lack at all. And he gives them to taste from his bread and his water — and they feel in them all the flavors, etc. And through this what has been corrupted in their case is also repaired.

And this Tzadik can also repair the good life of the entire world. And he makes known that the essential corruption of their good life comes to them from the evil character traits that the adversary has implanted within them. Namely — through there being no truth among them, and they pervert justice and show favoritism and take bribes — through this the sight has been corrupted in their case. And through obscene speech, the flavor has been corrupted in their case — for all the flavors are the flavor of neveilah. And through actual licentiousness (taavas ni'uf), Heaven forbid, the fragrance has been corrupted in their case. And he warns them greatly to purify themselves from these transgressions. And then, not only is the flavor and the sight and the fragrance repaired in their case — but they also merit to find through this the gardener who was lost. And then the aforementioned Tzadikim acknowledge the truth and make known to the world that the entire repair of the aforementioned Tzadikim themselves — and likewise the repair of the entire world — depends only upon the deaf Tzadik.

When the year arrives at being completed and coming to an end — meaning the last month of the year, which is the month of Elul, when it is the days of favor and holy yearnings — certainly one must be very aroused and strengthened with great desires and yearnings to Hashem Yisburach. And to seek and to search and to investigate the path of teshuvah — each one from the place where he is. And to prepare oneself to receive the new creation of the coming year. And to remind oneself that the approaching holy Rosh Hashana is coming — such a holy day, which comes from the place it comes from — through wondrous riddles and songs. Therefore a person must also join himself to this — and to pray with new desire and passion. And to draw upon himself the merit and the power of the very great man of kindness — through whom the essential existence of the world and all creation was created at that time.

There are two birds — one male and one female. And they are only one pair in the world. And these two aforementioned birds strayed and became distanced from one another — to the point where they cannot find one another. And when the night comes they wail with a very great wailing — for each one wails over its mate. And these two birds hint in their root to the union of the Holy Blessed One and the congregation of Israel. And there is one Tzadik who has a very beautiful and wondrous neck — and a most wondrous voice. And all the kinds of voices in the world — he can produce all of them with his voice. Meaning that he can aim to make with his voice like all the kinds of voices that exist in the world — of all kinds of living creatures and birds and all kinds of musical instruments and the like. And he can also project his voice — meaning that in the place where he produces the voice it will not be heard at all, only in the distance will the voice be heard there. And through this he is able to draw and to join the two birds that have strayed from one another — and to unite them with one another, and to quiet their wailing, and to complete the repair in perfection. For the essential redemption depends upon the joining of these two aforementioned birds.

But because there are the vanities of the world — and this aforementioned Tzadik does not wish to emit any vanity or spirit or breath upon the vanities of the world — therefore he specifically appears in the eyes of the world as if his neck is crooked. For he truly twists his neck entirely away from the vanities of the world — and does not wish to emit any vanity or spirit upon the vanities of the world. But in truth his neck is not at all crooked — on the contrary, he has a straight and most beautiful neck as above.

The essential mitzvah of Chanukah is to kindle and to illuminate the light of truth in the world — so that all merit to know where the true Tzadik is, who is the most select truth among the Tzadikim. One must intend in the kindling of the Chanukah candle — that through this we merit to draw down the illumination of truth, and merit to draw close to the point of truth always.

The essential miracle of Chanukah is that the kingdom of wickedness — which is the aspect of falsehood, the aspect of the slave, the filth of the serpent — was subdued. And the holy kingdom of Israel was strengthened and exalted — which is the aspect of the King's Son, the aspect of truth.

When the days are already coming — and the person has reached the time of his old age and his end — and the day begins to grow dark. And when he sees that most of his years have passed — and he wishes to begin to have mercy upon himself, to think about teshuvah and to draw close to Hashem Yisburach in truth — then most of the time the adversary strengthens himself and expands greatly — to prevent him from the path of life. And he does not wish to allow him to go out from his desires and his nets in which he has been trapped. And then the essential trial of the person — then he must look very closely at himself upon his end and his outcome. And overcome himself more and more — to bind himself well to the true Tzadik — the aspect of Moshe-Moshiach — who fortifies us with a most great fortification without measure, worth or number. To strengthen ourselves to begin every time afresh — to draw close to Hashem Yisburach — as though he was born today. And not to fall because of anything in the world.

Through a light word of the Tzadik, a great light is opened — and then it is easy for people to attain lofty wisdoms. Through a light word of the Tzadik, a great light is opened — and then it is easy for people to attain lofty wisdoms!

When the days are already coming — and the person has reached the time of his old age — and the day begins to grow dark. And when he sees that most of his years have passed — then most of the time he wishes to begin to think about teshuvah and to draw close to Hashem Yisburach in truth. The adversary strengthens himself and expands greatly to prevent him from the path of life, Heaven forbid — and does not wish to allow him to go out from his desires and his nets in which he has been trapped. And then the essential trial of the person — then he must look very closely at himself upon his end and his outcome. And overcome himself more and more — to bind himself well to the true Tzadik, the aspect of Moshe-Moshiach — who fortifies us with a most great fortification without measure, worth or number. To strengthen ourselves to begin every time afresh to draw close to Hashem Yisburach — as though he was born just now — and not to fall because of anything in the world. And the essential thing is that one must overcome oneself against the aspect of smallness of mind (mochin d'katnus) — which overpowers a person greatly and wishes to topple him in his mind, as though he has no more hope, Heaven forbid. Only let him know and believe in the words of the true Tzadik who cried out with a great and strong voice: there is no despair in the world at all! For His greatness is beyond all reckoning — and through the greatness of His mercies Yisburach He is able to transform everything entirely — from evil to good, and from sins to merits through teshuvah!

The words of the true Tzadik who strengthens us greatly — to strengthen ourselves with good desires and yearnings toward Hashem Yisburach always in all that passes over us. And he makes known to us that there is no despair in the world at all. These words — we must be careful about them and implant them in our hearts like dew and like rain. For just as the dew and the rain descend, a drop of water falls upon the earth — and afterwards wondrous plants grow from them. So too we must implant these words into the very depth of the heart well — until they sprout in the heart and make good fruits. For these words — to always strengthen ourselves in Hashem Yisburach — we must hearken well and understand one thing from within another. To understand well the hints of the Tzadik — to what extent, to what extent we must strengthen ourselves forever. For it is impossible to explain at all the entire need for these words in particular — only through a hint that shows you the path. And hints to you: by this path go — and through this, etc. — to strengthen ourselves always with desires and yearnings and the cry that sometimes is there, etc. And the roar to Hashem Yisburach. And through this one will certainly in the end merit to a complete redemption — to return to Hashem Yisburach in truth.

The essential delay of the redemption is only through dispute. For in every generation there are found great and important people who contain sparks of Dathan and Aviram — and they strive to distance from the true Tzadik, the aspect of Moshe. And through this all the troubles and the destructions of now have unfolded. But even so, Hashem Yisburach is exalted forever. For also there are found in every generation true and worthy Tzadikim — who are joined to the great select Tzadik and rejoice to receive him, and heed his counsel. And through this the complete redemption will come!

Sometimes specifically when a person arrives at a very low and very distant place from the holiness of Israel — there specifically a great arousal to Hashem Yisburach will be awakened within him. And there are several reasons and aspects for this!
Bruder harziger, shreck zich nit, Gott iz mit dir, bei'a dir, leib'in dir — {My warm-hearted brother — do not be afraid. Hashem is with you, beside you, gives you life.}
The Tzadik calls and cries out to us in a very strong and deep voice: Givald, zait aich nit meyaish, kein yeyush iz gor nit faran den — {Gevald! Do not despair — there is no despair whatsoever!}

There is a matter where everything is transformed to good. My dear and warm-hearted brother — look well and contemplate the greatness of the immensity of the miracle and the wondrous kindness that the Master of Wonders performed with us in such a time of darkness. That He opened our eyes to see such a true point of truth — that it is impossible to hide it from our mind in any way. And we merited to be in the portion of the true Tzadik — the great and awesome new light, etc.

Even if the battle is long and very strong — and the greatness of the provocation with which they provoke against us is without measure. And our deeds are as they are — until we have fallen wondrously to the depths of the seas and the abysses. Even so, Hashem Yisburach will certainly complete His own work. And all these thoughts of teshuvah that come to a person in the days of his life — not one of them is lost. Even though one has not yet merited to proper teshuvah — and even if the adversary afterwards strengthens against him even more and he falls lower and lower, Heaven forbid — even so, everything that he was occasionally aroused to, in some slight thoughts of teshuvah — even as thin as a hairsbreadth — is never lost forever. And in the end he will have repair through this — through the accumulation of the thoughts of teshuvah. Through the power of the true leader Tzadik who is merciful — who vindicates all of Israel and looks only upon the good that is in each and every one of Israel. And gathers and finds all the good points in each person — even as thin as a hairsbreadth. And makes from them wondrous vessels and pipes — to draw conceptions of G-dliness through them upon each and every one. Even upon those who have fallen and descended greatly — to illuminate within them that Hashem is still with them and beside them, etc. And this is the essential source of their hope and their repair.

The essential salvation that is coming is only through faith. And the measure of faith is according to the leader of the generation. One must see to fulfilling the faith — through the illumination of the Tzadik, who is the collective of the Seven Shepherds (shiva ro'im). For he is the shepherd of faith — to repair it and to complete it. And on this account he is called "shepherd" — as it says: "and shepherd emunah — faith" [Psalms 37:3]. And the entire essential faith of Israel — he draws it down to the generation. And it is impossible to draw close to this Tzadik except through boldness (azus) — as our Sages said: "Be bold as a leopard" [Ethics of Our Fathers 5:20]. For there are shepherds of the sitra achra — and they too are the famous ones of the generation. And the essential source of their power is through boldness — and they are like dogs in their brazenness, in the aspect of "and the dogs — brazen of soul, they are the shepherds" [Isaiah 56:11]. And such is the face of the generation — like the face of a dog. And therefore, in order to be saved from them and from under their rule — it is impossible except through boldness — to stand against their brazenness. And then: "You have led with Your strength to Your holy abode" [Exodus 15:13] — meaning: through boldness one enters into holiness.

My beloved, my brother — my soul and my heart. The love of David and Jonathan — our love — will never be nullified forever. For it does not depend upon any passing thing. Look well and contemplate the immensity of the kindness and the wondrous salvation that Hashem Yisburach performed with us — that He opened our eyes to see such a point of true truth that has never been revealed since the days of the world. That it is impossible to conceal it from our minds any longer in any way.

How very sweet to us are the words of our Sages of blessed memory — in what they have hinted to us in their words about Rabbainu: "The halacha is like Rav Nachman, and the halacha is like Rav Nachman, and the halacha is like Nachmani."

The essential salvation that is coming is only through faith. And the measure of faith is according to the leader of the generation. One must see to fulfilling the faith — through the illumination of the Tzadik, who is the collective of the Seven Shepherds. For he is the shepherd of faith — to repair it and to complete it. And the entire essential faith of Israel — he draws down to the generation. And it is impossible to come to this Tzadik and to draw close to holiness except specifically through boldness — as our Sages said: "Be bold as a leopard" [Ethics of Our Fathers 5:20]. And as it is written: "You have led with Your strength to Your holy abode" [Exodus 15:13] — meaning: through boldness one enters into holiness. For there are shepherds of the Sitra Achra — and they too are the famous ones of the generation. And the essential source of their power is through boldness. And they are like dogs in their brazenness — in the aspect of "and the dogs — brazen of soul, they are the shepherds" [Isaiah 56:11]. And the face of the generation is like the face of the dog. And therefore it is impossible to be saved from them and from under their rule — except when one possesses very great boldness to stand against their evil brazenness. And likewise it is impossible to be saved from all the preventers and the disputants and the opponents — and to draw close to the truth — except through the boldness of holiness!

Through the revelation that everything is conducted by His will Yisburach — and there is no natural compulsion whatsoever — through this the fear of Heaven is created. For then one knows that there is reward and punishment, and it is relevant to fear before Him Yisburach. But when one falls into heresy — as though everything is conducted according to nature — there is no relevance to fear at all.

There are evil beasts that prey and devour — and they are the natural scientists who wish to show, according to their erroneous wisdom, that everything follows nature, and as though there is no will, Heaven forbid. And even the awesome signs that Hashem Yisburach performed with us — they place everything within the framework of nature. And these sages are the aspect of evil beasts — and they prey and devour many of our people who err after them, and hold the same opinion as them — as though everything follows natural necessity, Heaven forbid. And these souls are like birds trapped in a snare. Therefore anyone who has compassion for his soul must flee and deliver his soul from them — lest his soul be devoured and torn by them, Heaven forbid. Therefore it is absolutely forbidden to look at all into those books that speak of investigations — even books written by great ones of Israel. For there is no greater evil than this.

Even if our deeds are as they are — and we have descended as we have descended, and have fallen to the place where we have fallen — even so let us not worry and let us not be sad. For Hashem is with us and among us and beside us and close to us. And there is no despair in the world at all. For now, thank G-d, there is such a select Tzadik who repairs everything and transforms everything for good — and from sins merits are made. And therefore the more a person knows within himself that he is very ill — and his blemishes and his corruptions and his distancing from Hashem Yisburach are very great — the more he must seek and request the great Tzadik of most lofty stature, who will be able to heal even him. For the greater the patient, the greater the doctor that is needed!
The essential repair — in every place where one falls, even to the most distant places — is not to despair. And to seek and to search from there after His honor Yisburach!

When Israel corrupts their deeds greatly — to the point where the small amount of good within them is almost unrecognizable, because of the immensity of the multitude of sins and corruptions, Heaven have mercy — then the true Tzadik, who is the aspect of Moshe, advocates merit for Israel through the aspect of hairs. Through this it is possible to find merit even for the worst of the worst — for in all of them there are found some good hairs, something with which they draw themselves at times from evil to good — even as thin as a hairsbreadth! Through a person going after his wisdom and his intellect — and not wishing to fully nullify his intellect before Hashem Yisburach and before the true Tzadik — through this the mind becomes confused in foolish and false and erroneous wisdoms. Until he can turn and go entirely astray from the ways of Hashem — as we find with many who have turned from Hashem Yisburach and His Torah through their wisdom — and have fallen to the depths of the nethermost abyss, through standing upon their confused wisdom and intellect. And the essential wisdom is to cast away all the wisdoms — and to draw all the wisdom and daas that one has — to serve Hashem in simplicity and sincerity. And to entirely nullify one's intellect before Hashem Yisburach and before the intellect of the true select Tzadik!

One must remember well, well — all the days of one's life, every single day — the greatness of the kindnesses of Hashem Who performed such great things for him, and arranged awesome causes through His stratagems — to bring him close to the true Tzadik. Who has taken him out from the place He has taken him out from, and makes known to him that Hashem is still with him and will not remove His kindness from him forever. And even though what still passes over him passes — certainly the kindness and the good that Hashem Yisburach performed with him is certainly not in vain, Heaven forbid. And in the end Hashem Yisburach will complete His own work — and he will merit to return to his source in wholeness. For the word of our G-d stands forever.

The true Tzadik — who is of the most supernal and most exceeding lofty stature — the very ultimate of stature beyond which there is no higher — is able to lower himself very, very much to elevate even those most distant, who lie in the very lowest level — even to the point where they have descended to the very aspect of actual death. And this is the essential wholeness of his lofty stature — for it is impossible to ascend higher and higher except when one is able to descend lower and lower — to elevate and to gather also all the displaced and the utterly most distant — and to bind even them to Hashem Yisburach in wholeness.

And know — that the entire essential redemption, the entire essential redemption of our soul, and the redemption of the collective of the souls of Israel — depends solely and entirely upon this: that the light of the true Tzadik be revealed and shine forth in all the earth. And to raise the banner of the Tzadik in the world — until it becomes known to all the world — that through truly drawing close to the true Tzadik, all the wondrous lights shine — those that will shine through our righteous Moshiach.

The essential honor and greatness of the kingship is specifically through humility. And the more humility the king possesses, the more his kingdom extends. His humility I rely upon — to come and to speak before you what Hashem places beneath the pen.

I have already written about the matter of the love between us — that truly there are not found in the entire world men, brothers, faithful and true lovers such as ourselves. This has come from Hashem — from Heaven. And we must guard ourselves greatly — lest the love be blemished, Heaven forbid, even by a hairsbreadth. For it is fitting for us to hold ourselves in the love with even more power and strength — because we have merited to have a portion in the publicizing and the revelation of the true Tzadik in the world. From which will sprout the complete redemption for the people of Israel and for the entire world — that all will know Hashem and crown Him with the crown of kingship.

Know, my brother — and believe — that at the time of the beginning of your coming into existence in your mother's womb, it was decreed upon you by the Creator that you would be President over Israel. In order that with your broad and upright intellect and your pure and glorious tongue — you would teach the people this awesome truth that Hashem has revealed before your eyes through miracle and wonder — these seven years. And you would open the eyes and the hearts of Israel — so that all would see and understand the true truth, hidden and concealed and most secret from all eyes. Which is the essential source of our redemption and the deliverance of our souls and the repair of the world in perfection.

The essential honor and greatness of the kingship is specifically through humility. And the more humility the king possesses, the more his kingdom extends. For such is always the way of kingship — that it must preface humility before its honor and its greatness. "In your very place of greatness I find your humility" — to come and to speak before you what Hashem places in my heart.

My heart has been overturned within me — destroyed and demolished to its very foundation — and I am shattered with utter breakings without measure. And I sigh and weep with burning tears without pause — over the great loss that I have lost — with the passing of my righteous wife, may she rest in peace. I have no words in my mouth to tell of her praises, and to describe the greatness of the nobility of her holy soul. I console myself only with her wondrous righteousness and her beautiful and good deeds — that all the days of her life she merited to perform with self-sacrifice, from within poverty and distress and many bitter afflictions the like of which have no equal in the world. And all her aim and desire was to sanctify the name of Hashem and the name of the Tzadik — as is known to you somewhat of this. From the very depths of my heart I bless all of you — with the blessing of "Blessed be he who has come." And especially to your nephew who has merited to tread upon the holy soil of the land of our forefathers — the land of our desire and our hope, the land of our rest and our consolation — the place of faith and the holy wisdom, to know the Creator of the world Yisburach. May he receive blessing from Hashem — and may they succeed in all that they turn to — in the physical and the spiritual — for long and good years.

Hashem — through the multitude of the hidden recesses of His sealed and concealed ways and conduct, hidden from all thought and all investigation — has rained upon the earth a heavy rain and a torrent of mighty waters of heresies and apostasy in these latter days. Until all the high mountains — which are the honored and the prominent — were covered. And through His abundant compassion He prepared healing and salvation in advance — and sent us a man after His own heart, whom He found favor. And He called his name Nachman — saying: "this one will comfort us from our labor and from the toil of our hands" [Genesis 5:29]. And He commanded him to build the ark of truth and faith — so that all who wish to be saved should come and enter into his chambers, and close the doors upon them, and hide in the shadow of his awesome wisdom. For who can praise and who can express the immensity of the sublimity of his heroic deeds — that he performed wondrously with his wonders — to prepare and to provide food and vitality for the people of his household and for all the souls of Israel for every generation. That they should delight and take pleasure in the splendor and the glory and the pleasantness of his awesome Torah teachings and stories — taken from the field of the most supernal lofty wisdom that has never yet been revealed in the world — which are enduring and faithful and beneficial forever.

In the future the Holy Blessed One will take vengeance upon the people of His nation — from those false prophets and false messiahs who fill their bellies with honor and arrogance. And who present themselves as the Tzadikim and leaders of the generation — and hunt precious souls and prey and devour them with a foot of arrogance and falsehood. And who blind the eyes of Israel from seeing the light of the true leader-Tzadik, who reveals and illuminates the light of Hashem to all who come into the world from generation to generation.

There are seven levels of Gehennom — and in each level there are seven thousand pits. And in each pit seven thousand crevices. And in each crevice seven thousand scorpions. And each scorpion has seven thousand joints. And upon each joint hang seven thousand vials of venom. And all of them are prepared for the wicked who speak about the true Tzadik with pride and contempt — and who mock and disgrace his holy books and his holy disciples.

The essential honor and greatness of the kingship is specifically through humility. And the more humility the king possesses, the more his kingdom extends. For such is always the way of kingship — that it must preface humility before its honor and its greatness. "In your very place of greatness I find your humility" — to come and to speak before you what Hashem places beneath the pen.

Know and believe that from the time of the beginning of your coming into existence in your mother's womb, it was decreed upon you by the Creator that you would be President over Israel — in order that you have mercy upon them with true mercy. And through the greatness of your upright intellect and your pure and glorious tongue — you would make known and teach the people this awesome and wondrous truth, which Hashem revealed before your eyes through several causes and wondrous workings — these approximately seven years. And you would open the eyes and the hearts of Israel — so that all would see and understand the true truth, hidden and concealed and most secret from all eyes. Which is the essential vitality and existence of all creation — and from it will sprout the final redemption for the people of Israel and for the entire world — that all will know Hashem and crown Him with the crown of kingship.

We have already spoken somewhat of the matter of the bond of unity and friendship between us — that truly there are not found in the entire world men, brothers, faithful and true, such as ourselves. This has come from Hashem — from Heaven. And we must guard ourselves greatly — lest the love be blemished in our case, Heaven forbid, even by a hairsbreadth. And it is fitting for us to hold ourselves in love — with more power and strength at every time always — because we have merited to have a portion in the publicizing and the revelation of the name of the true Tzadik in the world. Upon which depends the essential source of our hope and our repair and the repair of the entire world in perfection.

The essential honor and greatness of the kingship is specifically through humility. And the more humility the king possesses, the more his kingdom extends. For such is always the way of kingship — that it must preface humility before its honor and its greatness. "In your very place of greatness I find your humility" — to come and to speak before you what Hashem places beneath the pen!

Hashem — through the multitude of the hidden recesses of His sealed and concealed ways and conduct, hidden from all thought and all investigation — has rained upon the earth a heavy rain and a torrent of mighty waters of heresies and apostasy from the windows of the heavens in these latter days. Until all the high mountains — which are the honored and the prominent — were covered. And through His abundant compassion He prepared healing and salvation in advance — and sent us a man after His own heart, whom He found favor. And He called his name Nachman — saying: "this one will comfort us from our labor and from the toil of our hands" [Genesis 5:29]. And He commanded him to build the ark of truth and faith — so that all who wish to be saved should come and enter into his chambers, and close the doors upon them, and hide in the shadow of his awesome wisdom. For who can praise and who can express the immensity of the sublimity of his heroic deeds — that he performed wondrously with his wonders — to prepare and to provide food and vitality for the people of his household and for all the souls of Israel for every generation. That they should delight and take pleasure in the splendor and the glory and the pleasantness of his awesome Torah teachings and stories — taken from the field of the most supernal lofty wisdom that has never yet been revealed in the world — which are enduring and faithful and beneficial forever and ever.

In the future the Holy Blessed One will take vengeance upon the people of His nation — from those false prophets who fill their bellies with honor and arrogance. And who present themselves as the Tzadikim of the generation — and hunt precious souls and prey and devour them with a foot of arrogance and falsehood. And who blind the eyes of Israel from seeing the light of the true leader, who reveals and illuminates the light of Hashem to all who come into the world from generation to generation, forever.

Know and believe — that from the time of the beginning of your coming into existence in your mother's womb, it was decreed upon you by the Creator that you would be President over Israel in this orphaned generation — in order that you have mercy upon the people of Hashem with true mercy. And through the greatness of your upright intellect and your pure and glorious tongue — you would teach the people this awesome truth — the one and only in the world — which Hashem revealed before your eyes through several causes and wondrous workings — these approximately seven years. And you would illuminate the eyes of Israel — so that all would see the light of the true Tzadik, who is the essential vitality and existence of all creation. And from him will sprout the complete redemption for the people of Israel and for the entire world — that all will know Hashem and crown Him with the crown of kingship.

We have already spoken somewhat of the matter of the greatness of the loftiness of the bond of unity and friendship between us — that truly there are not found in the entire world men, brothers, faithful and true, such as ourselves. This has come from Hashem — from Heaven — in order that we merit to make known and to publicize the name of the true Tzadik in the world. Upon which depends the essential source of our vitality and our hope. We must guard ourselves greatly — lest the love in our case be blemished, Heaven forbid, even by a hairsbreadth. And it is fitting for us to hold ourselves in the truth, in wondrous love — with more power and strength at every time always.

Who longs and desires and yearns — to seek and to search and to request and to probe and to burrow — to find the hidden depths and concealment of the living waters that give life from the aspect of death, which is heresies and false faiths. And from which the holy faith grows throughout the entire world — which heals from all bad and bitter ailments of heresies and false faiths. And makes grow throughout the entire world the holy faith — a strong and correct faith, a pure and clear and lucid faith. Which is all our vitality and our hope. Who can express the heroic deeds of Hashem and His wonders and His immense kindnesses — that we have merited to such a new, awesome and wondrous light in this impoverished generation. What no previous generation has ever merited — to attain the path of life, the path of the true truth.

Behold — the entire world knows that the chosen Land of Israel from among all the lands was given by Hashem to the chosen people of Israel from among all the nations. And in the beginning, the Land of Israel was in our hands and our possession. And now — even the nations that present themselves as lovers and friends — they think evil against us, they provoke and mock us. They have sharpened their tongue with words that have neither flavor nor fragrance — and say to us: you are robbers who have conquered the land and the holy city of Jerusalem from the hands of Hussein and Nasser — may their names be blotted out — who wish to destroy us. May Hashem destroy them utterly — and may He rain upon them fire until they are consumed, and may their memory be cut off from the earth. And may they recognize and know that the word of Hashem stands forever.

In the Land of Israel one merits to go out from natural constraints — to know and to believe that everything is only through Providence. And through this one is saved from all the troubles. The air of the Land of Israel makes one wise — for there one hears all the words of the truly wise Tzadik. Through whose words a person becomes wise with true wisdom — to return to Hashem and to know and to recognize the One Who spoke and the world came into being. And this is the essential wisdom.

Blessed is the Good and the Beneficent — blessed is He Who bestows good kindnesses upon His people Israel. We are obligated to give thanks and to praise Hashem — for all the good that He has bestowed upon you and upon all Israel. That He preserved your soul in life and did not allow your foot to slip. Hashem knows the hidden things of the heart — He knows how much and how much I share in your pain. And the prayers and the weeping that I pour out for you before the Master of Mercy and Forgiveness — that He have compassion and mercy upon you and upon His people Israel, and send His word and heal you and restore you completely — for a long good life, a true life of faith and complete teshuvah. Through the power and the merit of all the Tzadikim — and at their head the true leader of this generation and all the generations to come: Rabbainu the awesome, the wonder most supernal above all the supernal — Rabbi Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman.
